sources.credit: Creative Assembly / OtherTomCA; CampaignMapToolkit public map archive
sources.redistribution: Only derived factual identities, centroids and border pairs are included; the raw map asset and toolkit implementation are not redistributed.

map.coordinates: x=column; y=row+(column%2)/2 in native map.hex coordinates

coverage.identity_validation: 173/173 existing world region IDs match exactly
coverage.method: Unique region pairs sharing one of six hex edges; no row wrapping

limitations: The public CA map source has no declared game patch and is not verified against an installed build.
Land borders include impassable terrain contacts. They describe geography; they do not certify each economic effect's in-game target semantics.
Sea and coastal borders are geometric contacts, including river/lake regions; they are not movement links, strait crossings, port access or trade routes.
Coordinates are territory centroids, not settlement positions or map polygons.
Only the Grand Campaign is covered; DLC campaign maps are separate sources.
